data.title: bn-8nz: Declarative playtest scenario runner
data.description: For bn-8nz: add strict versioned JSON scenario orchestration over Session, ordered eval/input/assert/capture, stable reports, contained artifacts, Lantern fixture, tests and docs.

data.body: HIGH: Capture dimensions are only checked for nonzero values, then forwarded to unchecked `u32` dimension arithmetic. A scenario with `zoom:4294967295` reaches `nearest_neighbor_scale`, panics at `session.rs:509` (`attempt to multiply with overflow`), exits 101, and emits no structured report; `cell` has analogous multiplication/allocation exposure in the spectrogram path. Large values below the overflow boundary can still request unbounded allocations. This violates the documented exit/report contract for schema-valid input. Enforce practical upper bounds and checked dimension/byte calculations before execution, and add subprocess regressions for both zoom and cell.

HIGH: Artifact uniqueness is keyed by the raw JSON string rather than the normalized filesystem path. `same//artifact.bin` and `same/artifact.bin` both validate and compare distinct here, but resolve to the same file. An end-to-end capture using those names exited 0 with `artifact_count:2`; the later screen-text write silently replaced the earlier PNG, leaving one artifact. Normalize validated components into a canonical relative `PathBuf` before duplicate detection and writing (with appropriate platform-aware handling), and add a regression proving aliases cannot overwrite.

MEDIUM: Unknown button letters are statically invalid scenario input, but they are not checked during schema validation. `buttons:"Q"` is accepted through setup, then becomes a stage failure/exit 1 at execution; when placed later it can also leave earlier mutations or artifacts behind. That is inconsistent with the strict-schema and exit-2-for-invalid-setup contract and with the other semantic checks performed in `validate_scenario`. Parse every input mask during validation and cover the exit-code behavior.

LOW: The authoritative spec leaves the capture stage as `{\"op\":\"capture\",...}` and names outputs without documenting their field types, defaults, or scope. In particular, agents cannot discover `zoom`, `from_frame`/`to_frame`, `window_frames`, or `cell` semantics and constraints from SPEC or command help. Spell out the version-1 capture object (including which range fields affect which artifacts and all defaults/bounds), ideally with a complete example; also either document the supported `--json` alias or keep tests on the advertised `--format json` surface.

data.reason: Blocking on two HIGH correctness issues: unbounded capture dimensions can panic/abort instead of producing the documented exit/report, and raw-string artifact uniqueness permits normalized path aliases to silently overwrite a prior capture while reporting success. Also requested upfront input-mask validation and complete capture-schema docs.

data.body: Fixed in f6c15fc: SPEC now documents every capture field, type-facing range/default, artifact scope, path normalization, input alphabet, and total-frame cap; the integration test now uses the advertised --format json surface.

Fixed in f6c15fc: zoom is bounded to 1..=16 and cell to 1..=8, all derived dimensions and byte sizes use checked arithmetic, spectrogram spans are capped, and subprocess regressions prove u32::MAX returns exit 2 without panicking.

Fixed in f6c15fc: capture names normalize to validated relative PathBuf values before duplicate detection and writing, with a Windows case-folded duplicate key. The same//artifact.bin alias regression returns exit 2 before creating the artifact root.

Fixed in f6c15fc: every input mask is parsed during validate_scenario, before Session creation or stage execution. A subprocess regression places an erroring eval before buttons Q and proves exit 2 occurs without executing the eval.

Verified fixed in f6c15fc. The CLI now bounds zoom to 1..=16 and cell to 1..=8, performs checked derived-dimension/byte arithmetic, and caps spectrogram ranges. I reran both u32::MAX subprocess cases: each exited 2, created no artifact root, emitted no panic, and the new regression covers both.

Verified fixed in f6c15fc. Validation now normalizes each relative path before duplicate-key comparison, and execution joins the same normalized representation. The original same//artifact.bin vs same/artifact.bin subprocess case now exits 2 before creating the artifact root; the regression exercises the exact alias.

Verified fixed in f6c15fc. validate_scenario parses every input string before Session creation/execution. The original scenario with an earlier erroring eval and later buttons Q now exits 2 without running the eval or creating artifacts; the regression covers this ordering guarantee.

Verified fixed in f6c15fc. SPEC now defines capture field meanings, defaults, bounds, range scope, total-frame cap, button grammar, normalization behavior, and the advertised exit contract; the test also uses --format json.
